Title: Traqen 应用架构. Subtitle '模块职责与依赖'. Fit clearly on a large landscape canvas, no tiny text.
A blue enclosing 'Traqen 平台' boundary contains these sections:
1 接入: A1 Web UI（展示与交互）→ A3 REST API（请求与授权）→ S1 应用用例（编排与事务）. A2 操作 CLI（操作命令）→S1 as separate input.
2 应用协作 below S1: S2 分析作业（分析进度与恢复）, S3 材料访问（范围校验与切片）, S4 理解核查（比较语义与证据）, X3 证据摄取（验签、绑定与入库）. Group label 'S1 组织用例协作' (not every module called every request).
3 Divide lower platform area into three visually distinct columns:
Left blue '纯领域计算': D4 domain / 主张、治理、测试规格、证据规则、追溯与影响 / '规则计算，不执行外部 I/O'. Arrow S1→D4 '规则调用'.
Middle lightgray '分析与提取': D2 scanner / 材料解析与确定性提取; D3 analysis / 调查规划、模型适配与核查. Arrow S2→D3 '分析编排'; S1→D2 '提取用例'. D3 caption '能力选择与业务分流职责分开'. Do not say scanner or analysis entirely pure.
Right AMBER column 'D1 source-truth：规则与 I/O 复合模块' containing nested two boxes D1a '来源身份与策略规则' (identity / policy) and D1b '采集、存储与发布适配' (git-process / blob-store / postgres-archive). D1b→D1a '校验'. Arrow S1→D1 '来源用例'. This whole D1 column must be outside pure-domain section and MUST explicitly span rules plus I/O; NOT claim directory was refactored.
4 Bottom storage/adapter band: M1 存储端口 → M2 内存适配／M3 PostgreSQL适配. S1→M1 '持久化合同'. D1b→'Git／文件卷／PostgreSQL' labeled I/O. Use no domain→db arrow.
5 Right slim crosscut box H1 能力与授权配置; H2 准入检查／建议性影响结果. Footer '影响结果提供建议；准入检查可拒绝不合格输入。'
Outside platform bottom separate amber '目标执行边界': X1 测试 Runner（验任务、执行、签证据）→X2 被测环境（受控测试）, X2→X1 '观察'. X1→platform X3 arrow '签名证据'. Absolutely NO S2→X1 arrow, NO storage→Runner arrow, NO implied shared bus connecting them. Footer '分析作业与测试执行分离；测试任务传输合同见 C06。'
No tech stack version strings or zero-web-framework claim. No status badges or commit hashes. Keep every label large.

Title: Traqen 数据架构. Subtitle '概念对象与生命周期关系'. Four roomy panels G1/G2/G3/G4 on a landscape sheet. No huge unused margins. Draw only listed edges, all distinct and labeled, no generic shared vertical bus.
G1 身份、分析与权威:
Workspace→Feature／版本 label '0..* 归属'; Feature→Candidate label '0..* 调查候选'.
Candidate→'Agent 分析条目' ORANGE arrow '核查后自动收录', node caption '分析态，保留依据与范围'. This path bypasses all human approval boxes.
Candidate→CandidateReview arrow '0..1（同一 run）'. CandidateReview subtitle '候选审核记录'; CandidateReview→Claim版本 arrow '0..1（确认／例外关联）'; human_decision→Claim版本 arrow '1（精确版本）'. Human_decision caption '人工权威决定'. No arrow from analysis entry to human_decision. Panel footer '自动分析条目与 Claim 的字段映射见 O04；人工权威独立记录。'
G2 来源与事实:
已发布 SourceBundle→SourceTruthReceipt label '1..* 签发'; SourceBundle→ArtifactInventory label '材料清单'. Receipt→CoverageGap label '0..* 来源限制'.
SnapshotManifest→FactBundle label '0..* 提取产物'. Make 0..* VERY clear and include caption '未提取：零事实包'. SnapshotManifest caption 'source／build／deployment／runtime'. No Inventory→Snapshot line.
G3 测试与验证:
Claim版本 ↔ TestSpec版本 label '多对多 关联'. TestSpec版本→TestExecution '0..* 执行'; TestExecution→Evidence '0..* 证据'; Evidence→VerificationResult '0..* 评估'. Caption '未执行／未回传／未评估均保留零态'. VerificationResult caption '派生验证状态；按规格、快照与执行限定'. This is NOT Claim content writeback.
G4 变更与缺口:
ChangeSet→'SnapshotManifest（from）' label '1 变更前'; ChangeSet→'SnapshotManifest（to）' label '1 变更后'. Two role-nodes for SAME snapshot type, not two types. caption '每个快照可参与 0..* 次比较'. TraceGap node '缺失／陈旧／冲突／失败'→'功能／主张／范围／快照' arrow '受影响上下文'; ChangeSet→TraceGap arrow '可选变更来源'. Footer 'Gap 可独立产生，不以 ChangeSet 为前提。'
Bottom shared legend: '箭头＝引用／产生关系；基数按箭头方向，表示每个起点可关联的终点数量。' '内容版本与历史记录保留；图谱头、草稿与偏好可受控更新。' '本图为概念关系，物理表与发布 Schema 见正文。'
Do not label everything append-only; no implemented badge or commit. Cardinality 0..* at BOTH Snapshot→FactBundle and Evidence→Result absolutely mandatory. TestExecution→Evidence also 0..*. Keep all Chinese readable; prioritize exact edges.

Title: Traqen 部署架构. Subtitle '候选单节点拓扑与恢复边界'. This whole diagram is proposed deployment; no individual implementation badges.
Top main topology: B 浏览器 → E1 Cloudflare 边缘（Web资产与请求入口） labelled HTTPS. From E1→P0 源站接入（网络方案 A／B） (reference lower panels, don't imply selected). Main host big blue enclosure '平台主节点 · 单实例形态' containing P0, P1 Node API／分析作业宿主, P2 PostgreSQL, P3 持久文件卷, P5 模型 CLI 子进程. P0→P1 '本机 HTTP'; P1↔P2 'SQL／TLS 配置'; P1↔P3 '材料字节／检查点'; P1↔P5 '获准上下文／输出'.
Outside main host RIGHT: E7 模型服务, P5→E7 '授权调用'; E7→P5 '模型输出'. BottomRIGHT outsidehost amberbox E3 测试 Runner↔E8被测系统 labelled受控执行/观察. P1→E3 '签名任务（C06）'; E3→P1 '签名证据（C06）'. Distinguish model CLI from testRunner. Outside LEFT E2Git／上传来源→P1 '固定版本材料'.
Separate orange enclosure BELOW mainhost '独立故障域：配套恢复目标' contains P4 数据库恢复点＋来源内容集合＋完成清单. P2→P4 '数据库一致性备份'; P3→P4 '被引用来源内容'. P4→platformhost '隔离恢复与完整性校验'. DO NOT put P4 inside single-node enclosure.
BOTTOM two CLEAR independent NETWORK OPTION PANELS, labeled as alternatives with global heading '网络候选 A／B（择一）':
A: CF 边缘 ⇄ cloudflared连接器 [加密隧道；连接器主动出站]; cloudflared→Node [本机 HTTP]. Cost sentence '引入连接器与运行维护'.
B: CF 边缘→Caddy／nginx [HTTPS＋有效源站证书]; 反代→Node [本机 HTTP]. Cost sentence '管理证书与源站访问控制'.
Never claim SQL SSL必需 or currentCF deployment proven. Footer '物理位置表示候选拓扑；实现证据与未决参数见正文。' '单实例故障会暂停服务；恢复承诺由演练给出。' Simple readable diagram not dense paragraphs. No invented HA/queue/cache.
